_comment: The `meta` theme's maze art (content sets R4): SHAPES ONLY, no image file. A world that knows it is a generated game draws itself as a diagram: a floor is a paper cell with a corner tick, a wall a hatched block, the player a marker, each object one plain mark. One style: a 20x20 box (the maze's TILE_PX, so a recipe draws 1:1 in play), stroke width 2 everywhere, a small flat palette — paper #c4c9d2, ink #2e3440, slate #4c5464, the Gate's grey-blue #a0a8b8, and the maze's own meaning colours (exit green #3aa85a, mana cyan #5ac8e8, trap yellow #e0c040, block tan #c8a06a, struck #d05a3a, dormant #7ab8d8, button #ffd75f, pulser #e0e070, pull #a8401a) plus one accent for the player, #e8743a. Every key of the maze's key table (mazeRoom/mazeTileArt.js MAZE_ART_KEYS) is drawn; what the painter draws over a thing (the facing tick, a lane tint, a pulser's ring, a pull's disc, a collected tile's fade, the grid) is unchanged and stays readable on these marks. Art is presentation only: nothing here changes what the world is.

maze:tile/floor.note: a paper cell with a faint corner tick at its top left

maze:tile/wall.note: a slate block ruled with diagonal hatching in the Gate's grey-blue (the hatch lines meet across neighbouring walls)

maze:tile/exit.note: an open exit: a green box outline with a green arrow inside, on the floor (a closed exit stays the solid red fill)

maze:tile/entrance.note: the entrance: four green corner brackets, so it still shows around the player who starts on it

maze:tile/mana.note: a mana refill: a hollow cyan diamond with a plus sign in it (the painter fades it once collected)

maze:character/player.note: the player: an orange disc ringed in ink with a paper centre, a map's you-are-here marker (the black facing tick is drawn over its edge)

maze:object/trap.note: an arrow trap: a yellow warning triangle outlined in ink with an exclamation mark (its lane stays the armed/silent tint)

maze:object/block.note: a pushable block: a tan crate outlined in ink with an X across it

maze:object/block-struck.note: a struck block (fire, spear, a woken corpse): a red-orange block outlined in ink with an ink triangle pointing up — a block that strikes, not a crate

maze:object/block-dormant.note: a dormant block (a turret): a pale blue disc outlined in ink with a level dash — asleep

maze:object/button.note: a button, UP: an empty paper plate outlined in ink with a yellow knob standing in its middle

maze:object/button-down.note: a button, DOWN: the same plate filled yellow with the knob pressed flat to an ink dot (the plate's corners show around the player or block on it)

maze:object/pulser.note: a pulser's body: a small yellow square outlined in ink with an ink centre dot, on a paper disc so the armed/silent ring the painter strokes round it reads on a wall

maze:object/pull.note: a pull's trap cell: a dark red ring around a dark red centre, a target that draws things in (its disc stays the live/inert tint)
